content.short: ARQ, formerly DolarApp, is a Latin American app for holding digital dollars and euros with a spending card.
content.description: ARQ, formerly DolarApp and rebranded in 2026, is a Latin American fintech that gives users in Mexico, Argentina, Colombia and Brazil access to digital dollars and euros. People convert local currency into the USDc and EURc stablecoins, hold stable value against inflation, spend with the ARQ card that earns cashback, send international transfers and invest in stocks and ETFs. The company reports around 2 million users and has raised 70 million dollars from investors including Founders Fund, Sequoia Capital, Y Combinator and Kaszek.
